notes: Fighters and hoopers are ripped now: delts, pecs, arms, abs, quads and calves are sculpted in light and shadow. New sneakers and jersey trim on the court. Finishers freeze on stark manga-style impact frames with speed lines (knockouts get a quick one). Blood and sweat: after half health you get cut, and it gets worse the lower you go; sweat builds over the fight, makes the skin shine and flies off the face when you get hit; bleeders splash the mat. Turn blood off in Settings if you like.
